cielorraso_sin_luces.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square albedo texture for a flat suspended office ceiling in a low-poly pixel-textured nocturnal gas-station horror game. Orthographic front-on flat scan, exactly four by four square off-white vinyl acoustic ceiling tiles with narrow charcoal aluminum seams, modest gray age stains, fine mottled grungy porous vinyl texture. Subdued neutral ivory/light gray base color, unlit even ambient light, no baked shadows, no perspective. No lamps or luminous panels anywhere; all 16 cells are plain solid ceiling tiles. Both horizontal and vertical edges must tile exactly seamlessly. No border, no text, no watermark. Use subtle PS2-era texture detail so it fits an austere desaturated teal fluorescent shop.

vidrio.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square grayscale glass grime mask texture used to subtly vary alpha on transparent refrigerator doors and shop windows in a low-poly nocturnal horror game. Orthographic flat scan of a lightly used clear glass pane, mid-dark charcoal gray background representing clean glass. Very faint low-contrast slightly lighter wipe swirls, a few scattered tiny dust flecks, soft smudges and thin interrupted dried water trails. Overall overwhelmingly clean and transparent, subtle unevenness visible up close; do not create frosted glass, opaque dirt, scratches, cracks, solid objects, window frames, specular highlights or perspective. Seamless tileable edges, no text, no watermark. Grayscale bitmap, not a picture of a framed window. This is a scalar mask rather than a rendered reflection, brightness variation restrained.

proyeccion.uso: Proyección sobre recortes de geometría y periferia continua para observar desde el interior del almacén.

exterior.suelo: Cemento procedural con lugares para autos, vereda y cordón; el exterior no se superpone al piso del edificio.
exterior.reflejos: El vidrio refleja el cielorraso; no se proyectan luces exteriores sobre el piso interior.
